query.description: (Optional) Comma separated Policy Ids to find
(Optional) Return only default or custom policies
(Optional) Expand each policy's roles and user count. Off by default: policies come back bare for a fast bulk lookup. Full user objects are only returned by the get-by-id endpoint.
